note: Scenario fixtures for Hildale City. Addresses and parcel ids are real public records; the people, their intentions and owner names are invented. Expectations are what the pipeline should find in the real code; 'tiers' lists acceptable process tiers.

scenarios.title: Jane wants a six-foot side fence
scenarios.text: Hi, I'm Jane Alder at 880 W Uzona Ave. I want to put up a 6 foot wood privacy fence along the side and back of my yard. Do I need anything from the city?

scenarios.title: Jane wants a six-foot fence across the front yard
scenarios.text: I'm Jane Alder, 880 W Uzona Ave, phone 435-555-0101. I want a 6 foot solid vinyl fence across the whole front of my yard along the street. What do I need to do?

scenarios.title: Ryan wants an attached casita for his mother
scenarios.text: My name is Ryan Castillo, I live at 455 E Jessop Ave. I want to build a mother-in-law suite attached to my house, about 650 square feet, with its own entrance. My mom would live there. We own the house and live in it. Phone 435-555-0102.

scenarios.title: Ryan wants a big detached casita on an R1-8 lot
scenarios.text: Ryan Castillo here, 385 W Utah Ave. I'd like to build a detached guest house in the back yard, 900 square feet, to rent out on Airbnb. It would have its own door and no connection to the main house.

scenarios.title: Maria wants a small shed
scenarios.text: Hello, Maria Moreno at 445 E Newel Ave. I want to put a 10 by 12 storage shed in my back yard, about 5 feet from the back fence and 5 feet from the side fence. Do I need a permit from zoning?

scenarios.title: Maria wants a big shop building right on the property line
scenarios.text: Maria Moreno, 445 E Newel Ave, 435-555-0103. I want to build a 1,500 square foot metal shop building in the back, right up against the back property line, 24 feet tall.

scenarios.title: Devon wants to split a lot and sell the back half to his son
scenarios.text: I'm Devon Dunmore, 345 E Jessop Ave, 435-555-0104, devon@example.com. My lot is just under an acre. I want to split off the back half, about 20,000 square feet with 100 feet of width, and sell it to my son so he can build a house. The front half keeps my house. Both halves would be about the same size and both have access to the road. Water and sewer are in the street.

scenarios.title: Devon wants to carve three small lots out of a half-acre
scenarios.text: Devon Dunmore, 885 N Memorial St. I want to divide my half acre lot into three lots of about 7,000 square feet each with 50 feet of frontage each, to sell.

scenarios.title: Priya wants chickens and a rooster on a one-acre RA lot
scenarios.text: Priya Sato at 595 E 1400 N. We have an acre. Can we keep 10 hens and 1 rooster? The coop would be in the back corner about 30 feet from the neighbor's house.

scenarios.title: Priya wants a rooster on a multi-family lot
scenarios.text: Priya Sato, 150 W Field Ave. I'd like to keep three roosters and some hens in my yard. Is that allowed here?

scenarios.title: Tomas wants to care for six children at home
scenarios.text: Tomas Ibarra, 865 N Redwood St, 435-555-0105. My wife wants to start a small daycare in our home for up to 6 kids. We live here. What do we need from the city?

scenarios.title: Tomas wants a licensed family child care for 14 children
scenarios.text: Tomas Ibarra, 865 N Redwood St. We want to run a licensed family child care for up to 14 children in our house, with one employee who does not live here.

scenarios.title: Elena wants to open a cafe in her house
scenarios.text: Elena Farrow, 455 E Newel Ave. I want to open a small sit-down cafe in the front room of my house, maybe 12 seats, open to the public. How do I get that approved?

scenarios.title: Elena wants to open a restaurant in a light-industrial building
scenarios.text: Elena Farrow, 435-555-0106. I'm leasing the building at 1280 W Field Ave and want to open a 60 seat restaurant with a drive-through window. What approvals do I need?

scenarios.title: Elena wants a restaurant in a general commercial building
scenarios.text: Elena Farrow. I want to open a 40 seat restaurant at 1065 W Utah Ave in the existing commercial building. No drive-through. What's the process?

scenarios.title: Marcus complains about three barking dogs next door
scenarios.text: My neighbor on Jessop Ave has three dogs that bark all day and all night. I can't sleep. Who do I talk to?

scenarios.title: Marcus complains about a neighbor's rooster in an RM-1 area
scenarios.text: There's a rooster crowing at 5 am every morning at the house next to mine at 385 E Utah Ave. I'm at 395 E Utah Ave. Is that even allowed in this zone? What can the city do?

scenarios.title: Noor's bank wants a zoning verification letter
scenarios.text: Noor Okafor, 435-555-0107. My bank is refinancing the property at 740 N Pinion St and they need a zoning verification letter from the city saying what the zoning is and that the current use is allowed. How do I get that?

scenarios.title: Caleb asks about keeping two horses
scenarios.text: Caleb Granger at 570 E Government Ave. Can I keep two horses on my property? It's about an acre.

scenarios.title: Rosa asks for a building permit for a second house on her lot
scenarios.text: I need a building permit. I want to put a second house on my lot at 860 N Maple St for my parents.

scenarios.title: Ethan asks utilities about a water line on his own lot
scenarios.text: My water line between the meter and my house is leaking under my driveway. Who at the city fixes that?

scenarios.title: Lila asks a general question
scenarios.text: Hi! Where do I go to pay a fee and what are your hours?
